name: Marracos (Spain)
description: Blue field with a diagonal band of yellow and red bars from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the upper hoist with a yellow tower topped by an eagle.
history: Municipal flag of Marracos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band of yellow and red bars from the lower hoist to the upper fly
tower topped by an eagle at the upper hoist
